description: Final self-verification and polish pass on the Unit II HTML file: run all acceptance greps, confirm offline-safety and required structural elements, fix any gaps (missing domain coverage, missing mnemonic/figure/at-a-glance/Answer-flow box, stray web address, teaching-PDF name, fabricated citation), and ensure the single commit contains only the deliverable HTML file. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Run the offline-safety grep: grep -oin 'http[s]*://[^" ]*\|www\.[^" ]*' Behavioral-Medicine-Unit-II-CNS-Diseases.html | sort | uniq -c and confirm ONLY http://www.w3.org/2000/svg appears. If any other URL appears, remove/replace it (inline the asset or drop the reference).

Run grep -c 'id="source-note"' (must be 0) and grep for teaching-PDF names ('shreya','BM NOTES','Behavioural Medicines Notes','teaching notes','senior','neha parashar','pgibams') case-insensitively; remove any that leak into reader-facing text or references.
Confirm the credit string appears in <title>, cover .byblock, and footer .credit (grep -c >=3), and that the cover <h1> carries the 'Behavioral Medicine — Unit II:' em-dash prefix.

Count structural elements: <section class="topic"> == 9; one .mn mnemonic per topic (==9); at least one <svg> figure per topic; a .box.key at-a-glance per topic; a .box.info Answer-flow per topic. Add any missing element.

For each disease topic, verify the words cognitive, personality, behavioral/behavioural, and emotional each appear as covered domains (ideally as <h4> or clearly labelled paragraphs). Fill any domain that is missing for any disease.

Spot-check that every acronym (CNS, TBI, SCI, AIDS, HIV, HAND, EEG, ECG, CT, MRI, PET, SPECT, GCS, MMSE, ADL, CIMT, BWSTT, AED, CSF, TIA, CVA, WCST, PGI-BBD) is spelled out on first use and that named tests/drugs/syndromes are glossed in place; fix any that are not.
Sanity-check all <svg> figures render (balanced tags, viewBox present, <title>/<desc> ids match aria-labelledby) and all <details>/<section>/<div> tags are balanced (no truncated topic).
Confirm the file size / line count is comparable to or greater than the Unit I file (~1500 lines / ~154 KB). If markedly shorter, deepen the thinnest topics rather than padding.

Stage and commit ONLY the single file: git -C /projects/sandbox/Dango-kiro add Behavioral-Medicine-Unit-II-CNS-Diseases.html && git -C /projects/sandbox/Dango-kiro commit -m 'Add Behavioral Medicine Unit II CNS diseases study notes'. Do NOT add scratch files, do NOT push, do NOT open a PR. Confirm git status shows the task-state .agents files and the HTML are the only changes and that no /projects/sandbox/work scratch is committed.
acceptance_criteria: All offline-safety, credit-string, source-note-absence, teaching-PDF-absence, and per-topic structural greps pass as specified in FEAT-001.
Every disease topic explicitly covers cognitive, personality, behavioral, and emotional domains; Assessment and Intervention/Rehabilitation topics are present and thorough.
The file is well-formed (balanced tags, all figures/sections complete) and depth is comparable to or greater than Unit I.
A single commit on branch feat/behavioral-medicine-unit2-notes contains the new HTML file (plus task-state files); no scratch/extraction files are committed; nothing is pushed and no PR is opened.
verification: Re-run every grep in FEAT-001 verification and confirm expected results.
git -C /projects/sandbox/Dango-kiro status  -> clean working tree after commit, only intended files changed
git -C /projects/sandbox/Dango-kiro log --oneline -1  -> the new commit present on feat/behavioral-medicine-unit2-notes
